primary_inference: Early Fusion significantly outperforms all 3 alternative models on clean data: vs Energy-Only (Mean Diff = -6.2463 W [-7.0532, -5.4851], Wilcoxon W = 31189.0, p_raw = 1.7032e-28, p_holm = 8.5159e-28, HLN-DM stat = -3.6934, p_hln = 2.4503e-04); vs Late Fusion (Mean Diff = -7.2682 W [-8.0401, -6.4093], W = 24263.0, p_raw = 2.2346e-38, p_holm = 1.3408e-37, HLN-DM stat = -5.2078, p_hln = 2.7594e-07); vs Hybrid Fusion (Mean Diff = -10.5502 W [-11.4502, -9.6010], W = 16275.0, p_raw = 6.4258e-52, p_holm = 3.8555e-51, HLN-DM stat = -6.4526, p_hln = 2.7020e-10). Late Fusion vs Energy-Only is not statistically distinguishable (Mean Diff = +1.0219 W [0.0151, 1.9961], W = 79930.0, p_raw = 0.1197, p_holm = 0.1197, HLN-DM stat = 0.8878, p_hln = 0.3751).

family_name: Family 2: Model Comparisons Under Missingness (30% MCAR)
primary_inference: Early Fusion maintains a statistically significant performance advantage over all models across all missingness conditions (N-A, A-N, A-A; all p_holm < 1e-16). Under dual missingness (A-A), Early Fusion outperforms Energy-Only (Mean Diff = -10.6177 W [-11.6441, -9.6738], W = 20387.0, p_raw = 1.2581e-42, p_holm = 2.2647e-41), Late Fusion (Mean Diff = -6.7493 W [-7.6416, -5.8118], W = 27725.0, p_raw = 6.9406e-35, p_holm = 1.2493e-33), and Hybrid Fusion (Mean Diff = -8.2147 W [-9.2435, -7.1651], W = 25056.0, p_raw = 2.9157e-31, p_holm = 5.2483e-30).

family_name: Family 3: Model Comparisons Under Noise (20% AWGN)
primary_inference: Early Fusion significantly outperforms all models under noise (all p_holm < 1e-16). Late Fusion vs Energy-Only is not statistically distinguishable under any noise condition: Noise N-A (Mean Diff = +1.0416 W, p_raw = 0.1163, p_holm = 0.3489), Noise A-N (Mean Diff = +0.6675 W, p_raw = 0.3529, p_holm = 0.6769), and Noise A-A (Mean Diff = +0.6872 W, p_raw = 0.3384, p_holm = 0.6769).

Asymmetric modality vulnerability confirmed: Electricity missingness (A-N and A-A) causes large, highly significant error surges across all models: Energy-Only (+9.1275 W, p_holm = 1.7858e-66), Early Fusion (+3.5640 W A-N, p_holm = 1.8057e-35; +4.7560 W A-A, p_holm = 3.9863e-40), Late Fusion (+3.3997 W A-N, p_holm = 1.8518e-21; +4.2372 W A-A, p_holm = 4.9307e-26), and Hybrid Fusion (+1.8880 W A-N, p_holm = 4.5447e-23; +2.4206 W A-A, p_holm = 1.1857e-26). Weather missingness (N-A) produces small effects: Energy-Only (0.0 W, p_holm = 0.5604, non-significant) and Early Fusion (+0.1743 W, p_raw = 0.2802, p_holm = 0.5604, non-significant), and small increments for Late Fusion (+0.6483 W, p_holm = 3.5918e-22) and Hybrid Fusion (+0.3635 W, p_holm = 2.1142e-19).

Negligible noise sensitivity: Across all three multimodal models (Early, Late, Hybrid), noise degradation (N-A, A-N, A-A) produces no statistically significant error increase after Holm correction (Early Fusion: Noise N-A p_holm = 1.0, Noise A-N p_holm = 1.0, Noise A-A p_holm = 0.6169; Late Fusion: Noise N-A p_holm = 1.0, Noise A-N p_holm = 1.0, Noise A-A p_holm = 0.9889; Hybrid Fusion: all p_holm = 1.0). Only Energy-Only under power noise (A-N and A-A) shows a small statistically detectable increase (+0.4352 W, p_raw = 1.0771e-04, p_holm = 1.2925e-03, dz = 0.1845).

Missingness causes statistically greater error increases than noise across all models under electricity (A-N) and joint (A-A) degradation: Energy-Only A-A (+8.6923 W, p_holm = 1.1702e-61), Early Fusion A-A (+4.6641 W, p_holm = 1.7561e-37), Late Fusion A-A (+4.1366 W, p_holm = 8.5610e-26), Hybrid Fusion A-A (+2.3879 W, p_holm = 2.3131e-27). Under weather-only degradation (N-A), differences are non-significant for Energy-Only (0.0 W, p_holm = 1.0) and Early Fusion (+0.1096 W, p_raw = 0.7148, p_holm = 1.0).
